project_identity.name: 0x13-firewall
project_identity.scope: Implementation and configuration of firewalls to secure servers, focusing on traffic filtering, port management, and security best practices.
project_identity.description: Covers firewall setup, UFW, iptables, port management, traffic filtering, and network security.

technicalSkills: Understand the purpose and importance of firewalls in system security
Learn how to install and configure UFW (Uncomplicated Firewall)
Master traffic filtering techniques for incoming and outgoing connections
Implement port-based security rules for services like SSH, HTTP, and HTTPS
Configure port forwarding for network services
Apply the principle of least privilege to network access
Develop competency in network security administration
Set up firewall monitoring and logging
Understand the differences between stateful and stateless firewalls
